name: 33170 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33170 (Miami) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33170 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33170 (Miami) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
